title: PIXL 8000 Blue Razz Cherry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Blue Razz Cherry PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod combines tart Blue Raspberry with sweet Cherry for a lively, fruity vape that balances sharp and smooth notes. This bold pairing delivers instant flavour appeal and is a popular choice in the PIXL range. Each pod holds 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and comes attached to a 10ml refill reservoir that allows up to 8000 puffs per kit when paired with the PIXL 8000 device. The mesh coil ensures consistently rich vapour and flavour from first draw to last. Designed for MTL vaping, this pod offers a hassle-free, satisfying vape with no coil changes or refills. Insert into the device, tap to activate Boost Mode, and enjoy a flavour that hits all the right notes. Part of the vibrant PIXL 8000 collection.
